2. The applicant-appellant is seeking condonation of delay of 970 days in filing the appeal.

3. The applicant-appellant is convicted by the judgment and order dated 15.11.2022 passed by Extra Joint District Judge and Additional Sessions Judge, Akola in Special (POCSO) Case No.62/2018,
whereby the applicant/appellant is convicted and sentenced under Section 324 of the Indian Penal Code and sentenced to suffer R.I. for three years and to pay fine of Rs.5000/- in default of payment of fine, shall suffer further S.I. for three months.

The applicant-appellant is also convicted under Sections 376(2) (i)(j)(1)(n) and 376 (3) of the Indian Penal Code and sentenced to suffer life imprisonment and to pay fine of Rs.1,00,000/- in default of payment of fine, shall suffer further S.I.
for six months.

The applicant-appellant is convicted for the offence punishable under Section 506 (II) of Indian Penal Code and sentenced to suffer rigorous imprisonment for seven years and to pay fine of Rs.5,000/-, in default of payment of fine, shall suffer further S.I. for three months.

The applicant-appellant is convicted for offence punishable under Sections 3, punishable under Section 4 of the POCSO Act and sentenced to suffer life imprisonment and to pay fine of Rs.1,00,000/- in default of payment of fine, shall suffer further S.I. for six months.
